texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰停止运转，观测分析子例程汇报了一件怪事。这些入侵者的舰船外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停止生产的型号别无二致。而且，这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的信号交换协议……不过是10年前的版本。
texts.en: As the last corvette is rendered inoperable, observation analysis subroutines report something abnormal. The invader ships are similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped producing years ago. Additionally, the ships lack FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our most complex handshaking protocols... from 10 years ago.

texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，一个运转传感器的工蜂汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。它是一个主脑不熟悉的、另一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]意识。
texts.en: As the last corvette falls, a drone manning the sensors reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's something this Mind is unfamiliar with, another [Root.GetSpeciesName] intelligence.

texts.zh: 随着最后一艘敌舰被击毁，在我们恒星基地内一位操作探测器的尉官汇报了一件怪事。这些舰船的外观与[Root.GetName]在多年前已经停用的型号别无二致。同时这些舰船也不具有超光速引擎，武器也相对老旧。汇报尚未结束时，一道通讯请求信号从怪异的裂口中发出，响彻了整个星系。这个信号使用的竟是我们最高级别的编码……不过是10年前的版本。
texts.en: As the last corvette falls, an ensign manning the sensors of our starbase reports something curious. These ships are very similar to outdated vessels that the [Root.GetName] stopped using years ago. The ships are lacking FTL drives and are equipped with obsolete weaponry. While the report is coming in, a communication request originating from the strange tear reverberates throughout the system. It's using our highest clearance codes... from 10 years ago.

texts.zh:
随着通讯画面闪烁显现，一串身份识别码被传来。校验和错误：这是[cloned_physicist.GetName]的专属ID！
“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉：此前的敌意行为是由[Root.GetName]-贝塔系统中冗余失效的分支军事机构导致的。它已被处理并删除。陈述：我们没有进一步敌意行动的意图。”
texts.en:
As the comms screen flickers on, an identification code is sent through. Checksum error: This is [cloned_physicist.GetName]s unique ID! 
"Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies: Previous hostile action was caused by a redundant and deprecated military branch of [Root.GetName]-Beta systems. It has since been dealt with and deleted. Statement: We intend no further hostile interactions."

texts.zh: 随着通讯画面闪烁显现，另一个意识的通讯工蜂拥有与[cloned_physicist.GetName]相同的意识结构。怪异。“你好[Root.GetName]-阿尔法，很抱歉。此前对你们发起攻击的工蜂是一些托管于独立设备过久的反常子个体。对于你们将其清除干净，[Root.GetName]-贝塔表示非常感谢。我们没有进一步负面行动的意图，愿意提出一些对我们意识双方均有利的提案。”
texts.en: As the comms screen flickers on the other Mind communication drone has an identical structure as [cloned_physicist.GetName]. Curious. "Greetings [Root.GetName]-Alpha and apologies. The drones that attacked you were deviants left to their own devices too long. [Root.GetName]-Beta appreciates that you exterminated them. We desire no more negative interactions and want to propose something beneficial for both our minds."

texts.zh: 随着通讯画面一同闪烁显现那张面孔在[Root.GetSpeciesName]看来是前所未见地疲惫、欣喜而又惶恐。[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]看起来太眼熟了，简直就是[cloned_physicist.GetName]老了20岁的翻版。“呃……你好[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-阿尔法，我是[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔”他停顿了一下，回了回神。“我，唔，我们……我们对刚才发生的意外非常抱歉。希望你们能理解，我们星球的防御集体中有一小撮冥顽不灵分子认为他们可以通过武力来夺取[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。我知道我的解释听起来像是狡辩，但请相信我，我们真的没有恶意。”
texts.en: As the comms screen flickers on, what looks to be the most exhausted, elated, and simultaneously terrified [Root.GetSpeciesName] imaginable appears. They look familiar, a dead ringer for [cloned_physicist.GetName] if [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] had aged 20 years. "Ah... hello [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Alpha, this is [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta" they stop to gather themselves. "I, uh, we... We are terribly sorry for what just transpired. You have to understand, that was a rogue and defunct element of our world's defense collective thinking they could seize [Root.GetHomeWorldName] by force. I know the words might sound empty, but please believe me when I say that we have no ill intention towards you."

responses.zh: 我以及这边的所有人来自一个与你们宇宙相似的平行宇宙。在我们也不清楚的过去某个时刻，我们两个现实发生了分支，我们的宇宙从那时起就一直在逐渐崩溃中。我们首先是从遥远的星系开始消失发现这件事的，并非常努力地研究以尝试避免这种末日的降临。在最近的几十年内，我们的一切资源和[Root.GetAdjective]时间都被投入到打开这个跨次元传送门上。只有通过这种最为试验性的技术和最尖端的物理学我们才能与你们会面，而现在离我们这边的现实毁灭已经不剩几年了。
responses.en: I and everyone else here are from a parallel universe to yours. We don't know when, but we believe that our two realities split some time ago, and our universe has been unraveling ever since. We first noticed when remote systems started disappearing and have been hard at work trying to avoid certain doom. For the last few decades, all our resources and [Root.GetAdjective]-hours have been invested in opening this trans-dimensional gateway. It's only with our most experimental technology and advanced physics that we have managed to reach you, just a few years before our reality ceases to be.

responses.zh: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔以及目前其他的所有单位都是来自平行宇宙。我们首次观测到贝塔宇宙的崩塌是在数十年之前，而首次发现遥远星系开始消失则是在55.136年之前。从那时起，我们调动了一切可用的资源与计算能力来打开这个跨次元传送门。据测算，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔只剩下25.3333年寿命了。
responses.en: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta and all other present units are from a parallel universe. Deterioration of universe Beta was first observed decades ago. Remote systems were first observed to disappear 55.136 years ago. Since then, all available resources and computation power have been put into opening this trans-dimensional gateway. Estimated time left until [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Betas erasure: 25.3333 years.

responses.zh: 我，[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔，以及目前其他所有属于蜂巢意识的成员都是来自一个与你们相似的平行宇宙。虽然不知道是何时开始，但我们确信很久以前我们共处的现实被一分为二，而归属于我们的那一半从那时起便逐渐走向崩溃。侦察工蜂在第一次发现遥远星系开始消失后发现了这件事，之后蜂巢意识便竭尽全力阻止末日的降临。在过去的数十年中，我们投入了所有的资源与研究力量，动员了全部工蜂来打开这个跨次元传送门。只有通过这种最为试验性的技术和最尖端的物理学我们才能与你们会面，这离我们这边的现实毁灭已经不剩几年了。
responses.en: This one, [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta, and all other members of the Mind present are from a parallel universe to yours. We don't know when, but we believe that some time ago our two realities split and our universe has been unraveling ever since. Observation drones first noticed when remote systems started disappearing, and this Mind has been hard at work trying to avoid certain doom ever since. For the last few decades, all drones, resources, and study has been invested in opening this trans-dimensional gateway. It's only with our most experimental technology and advanced physics that we have managed to connect with you, a few years before this reality ceases to be.

label.zh: 为什么你们好像没有超光速能力？
label.en: Why do you seem to be lacking FTL capabilities?

responses.zh: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔看起来被问住了，“你们成功地突破了光速？我的天啊这真是个天大的好消息！那么那些傻瓜真的没有理由进攻你们——整个星系我们都触手可及！唔……当然，前提是你们乐意帮助我们。”
responses.en: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta seems at a loss for words, "You managed to crack FTL? Oh, what glorious news! Then those fools had no reason to attack - the whole galaxy is available to us! Um... assuming that you would be willing to help us, of course."

label.zh: 阐明缺失超光速系统原因！

responses.zh: 用于通过超空间航道的超光速系统在理论上是可行的。不过我们认为该项目并非必要，而且所有资源都被投入到了传送门的研究之中，因此许多研究的优先级都被降至0。通讯结束后向[Root.GetName]-阿尔法查询结果？
responses.en: FTL systems capable of accessing hyperlanes were calculated to be possible but the project was declared non-essential and the resources were absorbed into the Gateway Research Collective. Many avenues of research had their priority set to 0. Request for [Root.GetName]-Alpha's results after communication is over?

label.zh: 为什么你们好像没有超光速能力？
label.en: Why do you seem to be lacking FTL capabilities?

responses.zh: 孪生意识蜂巢意识停顿了一会，才开始回答：“蜂巢意识不愿意在宇宙行将灭亡之时在超光速领域投入研究资源。请问能允许我们加入您的意识吗？”
responses.en: The other mind seems to need a moment before answering "This Mind was unwilling to invest resources into developing FTL systems when the universe was ceasing to be. Please allow us to partake in this understanding?"

label.zh: 别废话了。你们想要什么？
label.en: Enough talk. What do you want?

label.zh: 别废话了！阐明你的请求！

texts.zh: 我们已经建成了运输船，请求转移所有[Root.GetName]-贝塔之中的单位，并保全我们的资源与数据库，希望我们对浩瀚星宇的征程不会就此止步。
texts.en: Transportation ships have been built. Request to send over [Root.GetName]-Beta units to preserve resources and databanks. We do not wish to end our exploration of the universe here.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]-贝塔岌岌可危，而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，并会尽可能输送我们的子个体。
此外我们还希望能够融入你们的蜂巢意识。尽管诞生之初你我并无不同，但是随着时间推移，我们的经历与见闻也成为了无法割舍的东西。请让我们一同共存吧。
texts.en:
[Root.GetName]-Beta's universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this very day and would offer any drones we could send.
Additionally we wish to merge hiveminds. While identical at first this collective has had experiences and insights we don't want to lose. Please let us live on.

texts.zh: 我们的宇宙岌岌可危。而我们对此束手无策。我们为了这一天已经建造了巨型的运输船，恳求你们接纳我们的难民。只有最聪明和最优秀的领袖才有资格登上这艘船。请救救我的……我们的文明。
texts.en: Our universe is doomed. There is no way to get around that. We have been building giant transport ships for this day and implore you to let us send over refugees. Only our brightest and most capable leaders will fit on these ships. Please save my- OUR civilization.

label.en: We must confer with our experts.

label.zh: 需要进一步分析！请稍候！
蜂巢意识需要对请求进行处理。
label.en: This Mind needs to reflect on this request.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]控制下所有的超级计算机一齐运转，试图计算出关于当前[Root.GetName]-贝塔两难处境的最佳解决方案。最终，4个选项被认定可行。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：通过科学单元：[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的提议。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙。
texts.en:
Every supercomputer under the control of [Root.GetName] was put on calculating the most optimal solution to the current dilemma regarding [Root.GetName]-Beta. In the end, 4 potential options were declared viable.

1: Study collapse of Beta universe.
2: Enter gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Allow science unit: [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's proposal.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesName]全力思考如何决定[Root.GetName]-贝塔的命运后，4个潜在选线被给出。

1：研究贝塔宇宙的崩塌。
2：进入传送门并夺取一切有价值的矿物与能源储备。
3：接受[Root.GetName]-贝塔的请求，接纳孪生意识。
4：想办法利用高度试验性的贝塔世界科学技术，将[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带入阿尔法宇宙，合并孪生意识。
texts.en:
As the full might of [Root.GetSpeciesName]'s intelligence was put on the task of deciding the fate of [Root.GetName]-Beta 4 main potential solutions were proposed.

1: Study collapse of the Beta universe.
2: Enter the gateway and acquire all relevant stockpiles of minerals and energy.
3: Accept [Root.GetName]-Beta request and subsume the other Mind.
4: Attempt to use highly experimental Beta science and technology to bring [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into Alpha reality merging Minds.

texts.zh:
各领域的杰出人才在[Root.GetName]上汇聚一堂，决定我们的异次元孪生文明的终极命运。在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上发生了无数激烈而艰难的论战。有的人建议不要干涉，研究一个宇宙的消亡一定能收获颇丰。也有说法称应该接受[cloned_physicist.GetName]-贝塔的请求，尽可能多地撤离那颗行星上的人们。还有人提到趁机将他们留在星球上的有价值的资源及能量储存搜刮一空简直易如反掌。

随着峰会议论氛围的逐渐缓和，[cloned_physicist.GetName]走上讲台，[cloned_physicist.GetHeShe]宣称使用贝塔宇宙带来的新科技，应该有机会将整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔带到我们的现实中。
texts.en:
A summit of the top minds from every field gathered on [Root.GetName] to discuss the fate of our dimensional twins. Harsh and difficult debates were had throughout [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. Some suggested a hands-off approach. Studying the end of a universe could be very insightful. There was talk about granting [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Beta's request to evacuate as much of the planet as possible while some mentioned how easy it would be to take whatever precious resources and energy stores the planet had left.

Just as the summit was winding down, [cloned_physicist.GetName] took center stage and declared that [cloned_physicist.GetHeShe] believed that using the new technologies brought from the beta universe, there was a chance to bring the entirety of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta into our reality.

tooltips.zh: 我们不能在这样的任务上浪费资源，但我们也不能浪费这样的一个机会。
tooltips.en: We cannot spare the resources for such an undertaking, but we won't let an opportunity like this go to waste.

tooltips.zh: 这些傻瓜简直就是自投罗网！
tooltips.en: These fools have left themselves defenseless!

label.zh: 蜂群有更多的享用品了！
label.en: More for the swarm to feast on!
All things need to be exterminated, even them.

label.zh: 实现事业的单位增加了！
实现事业的单位增加了！
他们可不是外星人，让他们过来！
label.en: They are no aliens, let them in!

tooltips.zh: 开始一项拯救[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的艰难项目。
tooltips.en: Start a difficult project to save [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta.

texts.zh: 我们遭遇了一个位于“贝塔宇宙”内的糟糕境况，对于这个正在崩坏的次元，我们必须立刻决定是袖手旁观还是鼎力相助。
texts.en: We have been confronted with a terrible situation inside the 'Beta-Universe' and must now decide if we are to stand aside or assist the doomed dimension.

sections.zh: 将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙

sections.en: Observe the decay of the Beta-Universe

texts.zh:
停留在贝塔宇宙的探测器记录着那个世界最后的时刻，一道无形的虚无之壁吞噬了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]-贝塔，随后[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔也难逃厄运。裂隙开合之前的瞬间，探测器就突然内失去了联系，而裂隙产生的负相粒子也一齐消失了。

另一次元的一切都不复存在了。
texts.en:
Probes left in the Beta universe record the final moments of reality, as a formless static wall absorbs first [Root.Capital.GetStarName]-Beta and then [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta. The feed is abruptly cut off shortly before the rift winks out of existence. The negative mass particles it was producing are likewise gone.

Anyone left on that side is no more.

label.zh: 这种事情也可能降临到我们头上

texts.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的科学单元正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
texts.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta and all other available science units work side by side. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops being produced at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

texts.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔的工蜂正在通力合作的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。新的视点和意识加入了[Root.GetName]，并在整个集体意识中激起涟漪。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
texts.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta and all other available drones work side by side. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops being produced at its former location.

It is done. The new perspectives and minds joining the [Root.GetName] send a ripple through the Collective. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

texts.zh:
一道无形的虚无裂隙撕裂了[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的天空，就在[cloned_physicist.GetName]-阿尔法和贝塔正在通力合作完成他们艰难的任务的过程中，那道虚无也正在步步紧逼。负相物质稳定器激活后，有如虚空裂可能将其吞噬一般，世界间的缝隙拂过[Root.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔。缝隙很快化作一缕涟漪消逝了，负向物质逐渐不再在原有的位置显现。

终于完成了。在数个月对全新重力井和宜居带的的学习和研究之后，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]现在拥有了另一颗环绕着它的全新宜居星球。
texts.en:
A formless static covers a large swath of [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta's sky and is closing in rapidly as [cloned_physicist.GetName]-Alpha and Beta, working side by side, finish their arduous task. The negative mass stabilizers activate, and the tear between worlds moves over [Root.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta just as the static would smother it. The rift winks out moments later, and negative mass stops appearing at its former location.

It is done. After months of study and research accounting for new gravitational wells and habitable zones, [Root.Capital.GetStarName] now has a new inhabited planet orbiting it.

label.zh: 就这一次，大家都活下来了！

texts.zh: 在这么近的地方有一个镜像世界的好处就在于，如果[Owner.GetSpeciesName]的文化遗产被破坏或遗失，你或许可以在这个世界中找到备份，这样大伙们又可以重新瞻仰这些瑰宝了。不过一些可恶的家伙却以此为契机偷偷潜入[Target.GetName]-贝塔，然后将这些宝物窃为己有。结果我们现在有了整整两份由我们历史中某位伟大创作者缔造的杰作。[Target.GetName]-贝塔的政府现在向我们发来一份措辞严厉而正式的通告，要求我们归还被窃的作品。
texts.en: One of the great things about having a mirror world so near is that [Owner.GetSpeciesName] cultural pillars that might have been destroyed or lost in the last few years might still exist on the other planet, so everyone can enjoy them again. Yet unsavory characters have taken this as an opportunity to infiltrate [Target.GetName]-Beta and secure these great works for themselves. We now possess not one but two masterworks made by a great inventor from our past. [Target.GetName]-Beta's government has already sent an angry yet formal request for us to return the plunder.

label.zh: 返还这件大师之作并诚恳致歉。
label.en: Return the great work and apologize profusely.

label.zh: 多一朵镜中花，少一座维纳斯...
多一朵镜中花，少一座维纳斯...
多两朵镜中花，少一座维纳斯...

texts.zh: 在持续的困境下，另一个[Owner.GetGovernmentName]终于失去理智，狂躁地想利用[Owner.GetSoldierPlural]夺取[Target.GetName]！我们必须在防线被冲垮前组织好自己的防御子个体。
texts.en: In their continued distress, the other [Owner.GetGovernmentName] has lashed out and manically taken a hold of the [Owner.GetSoldierPlural] on [Target.GetName]! We must organize our defense drones before we are overrun.

tooltips.zh: 以100£pop£人口为代价获得400防御部队。
tooltips.en: Gain 400 defensive armies at the cost of 100 £pop£ Pops.

label.zh: 击败变异子个体，镇压贝塔星球。
label.en: Defeat the divergences, suppress the Beta-World.

tooltips.zh: 以100£pop£人口为代价获得400防御部队。
tooltips.en: Gain 400 defensive armies at the cost of 100 £pop£ Pops.

label.zh: 分析贝塔宇宙如此行为的原因。
label.en: Analyze why the Beta-Universe reacted like this.

label.zh: 分析贝塔宇宙如此行为的原因。
label.en: Analyze why the Beta-Universe reacted like this.

texts.zh: 自从裂隙出现之后，一种现象开始蔓延。处在我们次元的人们跑到他们在贝塔宇宙对应的孪生家庭那里，然后带他们偷渡到我们这个稳定的次元来。而偷渡很多时候就是由负责阻隔两个宇宙的边防哨卫进行的，毕竟[Owner.GetName]上谁在那边没有孪生家庭呢？如果只有一小撮人偷渡也就算了，但要是不加以制止，事情就会演变成恐慌性的逃跑。如果[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-贝塔的居民流失过多，那边的基础设施就会随之崩溃，那样的话想要将他们的星球转移过来就更难了。
texts.en: A common issue has started occurring ever since the rift appeared. Families in our dimension are reaching out to their Beta counterparts and smuggling them into our stable universe. This is often done by the border guards assigned to keeping the universes separate, as basically everyone in the [Owner.GetName] has family on the other side. A few groups doing this wouldn't matter, but we would quickly have a stampede on our hands if the practice spreads. If [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]-Beta loses too many inhabitants, their infrastructure will collapse, and it will be even harder to get the world through.

label.en: They should stay on their side.

texts.zh: 拥有第二个如假包换的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]给我们带来了一个意料之外的机遇。用来让我们的意识保持日常组织化的计算需要占用许多[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]，但这个任务现在可以分流到第二个[Root.GetName]上。这样做的价值是显而易见的，尽管可能会拖慢[Target.GetName]贝塔的拯救工作，但我们相信一切仍在掌控之中。
texts.en: Having a second [Owner.GetGovernmentName] which is so similar provides us with an unprecedented opportunity. The calculations required to keep our consciousness organized every day take up many [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural], but this task can now be offloaded to the second [Root.GetName]. The value of this is apparent, and while it might slow down the recovery effort of [Target.GetName]-Beta, we are sure we will still manage.

label.zh: 我们对完成这件事都很有兴趣。
label.en: It's in all our interests that this gets done.

label.zh: 他们需要能拥有的全部[Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural]。
label.en: They need all the [Owner.GetTeamMemberPlural] that they can get.

texts.zh: 贝塔宇宙的情况十万火急、每况愈下。今天上午传送门里又传来了联合呼救信号。即便我们尽了最大的努力，但可能我们的异次元亲戚们最终还是会被猎杀着他们宇宙的虚无所吞噬。如果我们想要拯救另一个版本的自己，那现在就是最后的机会了。
texts.en: The situation in the Beta-Universe is dire, and it's only getting worse. A unified cry for salvation was heard from the portal earlier this morning. Even with our best efforts, it seems like our kin will become one with the nothingness haunting their universe. If we want to save our alter selves, the time is now.

texts.zh: 今天，贝塔宇宙的传送门中再次传出了可怜的呼救声，啜泣着请求着我们的救援。我们从他们的惨境中获利已经有些时日了，因为无法在那个宇宙中与任何东西取得联系，他们还在尝试着向我们大声呼救。不可挽回的分水岭正在靠近，而很快，贝塔[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就将不复存在了。
texts.en: A pitiful cry for help was heard from the Beta-Universe portal today, a final whimper for salvation. We have been benefiting from their situation for a while, yet they still call out to us since there is no one to talk to in their lonely universe. We are approaching the point of no return. Soon, the Beta-[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] will be no more.

label.zh: 再加把劲，我们不能让他们止步于此。
label.en: Redouble our efforts, we can't let it end here.

tooltips.zh: 将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙应对方案将需要动员我们更多的科学家，总共降低研究速度-30%
tooltips.en: The Bring [Target.GetName]-Beta to our universe approach will require even more of our scientists, reducing our research speed by a total of -30%

label.en: All is going according to plan.

label.zh: 他们也是[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]啊！我们不能让他们就这么死去！
label.en: They are [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] too, we can't let it end like this!

tooltips.en: The Bring [Target.GetName]-Beta to our universe approach will require even more of our scientists, reducing our research speed by a total of -30%
